## Passages
RESULT [agents]: The best pairing of search policy and operators raised the MLE-bench lite medal rate from 39.6% to 47.7%. Search strategy, operator design and evaluation methodology have to be designed together.
US [agents]: The trainer agent's per-round decisions form a search. Selecting on the same split every round opens a gap to the true holdout, and AIRA_2 later traced that gap to evaluation noise. Use its final-selection lesson: shortlist several top rounds and confirm them on the sealed set, rather than trusting argmax on the gate set.
